project.name: Config: bdi-config-security-ldap
project.description: Standardized Active Directory / LDAP identity for the Elytron LDAP realm: HTTP Basic over TLS, users found by sAMAccountName under the users base, the password verified by binding as the user, roles from the AD groups the user is a member of, a short identity cache; the directory URL, the service account and the two base DNs are platform keys. Brings bdi-config-security.
